name: io.github.nzdsf2-gif/relayshield-free-mcp
title: RelayShield Scam Checks
description: Free scam checks for links, wallets, emails, and breach exposure. No signup.

tools.name: check_link
tools.description: Checks one URL, or up to 25 URLs in a single call, against RelayShield's threat-intelligence corpus for known phishing, malware, and scam abuse. Provide either `url` (a single http:// or https:// link) or `urls` (an array of up to 25 links). Returns a per-link verdict of FLAGGED or unknown with the reasons behind each verdict, plus counts of checked, flagged, and incomplete links. A verdict of unknown means nothing is known against the link; this tool never reports a link as safe.

url.description: A single link starting with http:// or https://. Omit when sending urls.
url.title: Url

urls.description: Up to 25 links to check in one call. Omit when sending url.
urls.title: Urls

tools.name: check_wallet
tools.description: Returns a read-only risk assessment of a cryptocurrency wallet address. It never moves funds or initiates transactions. Provide `address`; the chain (EVM, Solana, TON, or Bitcoin) is detected from the address format automatically. Returns a risk level of CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW, or unknown, with the specific sanctions, scam, drainer, and phishing flags behind it. A verdict of unknown means nothing is known against the address; it does not mean the address is safe.

address.description: Wallet address to screen. Chain is auto-detected.
address.title: Address

tools.name: check_email
tools.description: Scores a suspicious email for phishing signals from its parsed fields. Provide any of: from_address, from_name, reply_to, return_path, subject, body_text, and links (up to 25). Returns a risk level and score with the specific flags behind them; links in the email are also checked against RelayShield's threat-intelligence corpus. A verdict of unknown means nothing conclusive was found; this tool never reports an email as safe.

from_address.description: The claimed sender's address, e.g. alerts@phrase.com.
from_address.title: From Address

reply_to.description: Reply-To address, if present and different from from_address.
reply_to.title: Reply To

return_path.description: Envelope sender, if available. Informational only.
return_path.title: Return Path

body_text.description: Plain-text body, used for urgency/deadline/threat phrasing.
body_text.title: Body Text

links.description: Links found in the body, up to 25.
links.title: Links

tools.name: check_breach
tools.description: Checks whether an email address appears in known data breaches. Provide `email`. Returns the number of breaches found with the named sources behind each; a count of zero means no breaches were found in the corpus, not that the address is safe. Read-only: it only looks up breach records. Requires the RELAYSHIELD_API_KEY environment variable; without it, the tool returns setup instructions instead of calling the API.
